entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: A Moonfolk futurist wizard from Kamigawa who studied how kami bridge the mortal and spirit realms and developed the Reality Chip.

entities.name: Katsumasa
entities.description: Renowned moonfolk scientist under whom Tameshi apprenticed.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A young planeswalker, Tameshi's friend and apprentice, who wears one of Tameshi's drones.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: A device embedded in the skin that gives a mysterious connection to planar physics.

entities.name: Eiko Shizuki
entities.description: Kaito's sister who warned him about Tameshi.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Mysterious figure with whom Tameshi traded illegal merge studies.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: City whose Undercity Kaito followed Tameshi to.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who worked with Tameshi to learn to compleat a planeswalker without removing their soul and then killed him.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits of Kamigawa that Tameshi sought to protect.

events.summary: Tameshi apprentices under Katsumasa and makes origami drones to house kami, later developing technology letting kami merge into robot bodies.
events.quote: he later built on this design to develop a technology that made it possible for Kami to merge into robot bodies

events.summary: Tameshi gives a drone to Kaito Shizuki.
events.quote: He gave one of the drones to his friend, Kaito Shizuki

events.summary: Kaito meets Tameshi in Jukai Forest; Tameshi becomes his mentor and best friend for nine years.
events.quote: Tameshi became the young planeswalker's mentor and best friend

events.summary: Eiko warns Kaito that Tameshi trades illegal merge studies with Tezzeret.
events.quote: Kaito's sister Eiko warned him that Tameshi was involved in trading illegal merge studies

events.summary: Kaito discovers Tameshi was secretly working with Jin-Gitaxias, who kills Tameshi after getting what he needed.

relations.quote: Tameshi became the young planeswalker's mentor and best friend

relations.note: Killed him after getting what he needed.

relations.quote: he found that his friend had also secretly been working with the Phyrexian praetor Jin-Gitaxias
